description: A PHP class defining PluralTranslatableMarkup for handling plural translatable strings in Drupal, extending TranslatableMarkup, with methods for construction, rendering, and plural index calculation.

classes.name: PluralTranslatableMarkup
classes.description: Handles plural translatable markup with methods for construction, rendering, and plural index determination.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with count, singular, plural strings, and optional arguments, options, and translation service.

methods.name: createFromTranslatedString
methods.description: Creates an instance from an already translated string, ensuring correct pluralization.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the object as a translated string, handling plural forms and placeholders.

methods.name: getPluralIndex
methods.description: Determines the plural index based on locale and count using gettext formula.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares object for serialization, including 'count' property.
